limitations: Contextual literal adaptation covers imported qualified static calls and managed class method calls
Metadata headers are generated for explicitly selected types
Constructor arguments currently require exact supported CLI types
Generic consumption is partial; generic declarations/methods, constraints/variance and events remain incomplete
No mixed-mode PE output or ijwhost integration yet
Unsupported AST nodes are errors; this is not a conforming general C++/CLI compiler
Indexed properties currently require one index parameter; overloads require the same value type and accessor forms; static indexed/auto-properties and static compound updates remain unsupported

Interface-only implicit Object bases require directly recognized interface names; aliases and unresolved qualified source names still require an explicit Object base; interface-handle Object conversions remain incomplete

Interface methods and property accessors require declarations without bodies; named overrides cover one imported-interface target; source-interface renamed methods, target lists and class-target overrides remain unsupported
Managed arrays currently require rank one; aggregate initializers cover explicit static array-handle fields only; local/general array initializer forms and covariance remain incomplete
User finalizer declarations, value/interface destructors, covariance metadata and managed operator metadata remain unsupported
Native bridges require extern-C scalars or unmanaged pointers; bool/automatic marshalling, callbacks and automatic native partitioning are not enabled
Implicit primitive/interface boxing and multi-translation-unit linking remain unimplemented

The WPF DirectWriteForwarder assembly is compiled and has CLR/native font runtime proofs; System.Printing implementation, remaining desktop assemblies, WPF build tasks, full native rendering/text coverage and WindowsDesktop packaging remain incomplete
Value classes currently exclude bases/interfaces, virtual methods, native pointer fields and custom zero-argument constructors

Boxing covers explicit safe_cast to Object and implicit boxing into Object or matching selected value-class handles; handle upcasts, primitive boxes, constrained dispatch and boxed operator overloads remain incomplete

Tracking references exclude constructors, fields and tracking-reference returns; pin_ptr is restricted to primitive block locals and direct local assignments; general intrinsic pointer operations and interior assignments remain incomplete; arithmetic on explicitly spelled native pointers is supported for complete scalar/pointer/trivial POD or GC-free value elements
Layout attributes currently appear individually before managed declarations; inherited layout types, bitfields and general custom attributes remain unsupported
CLI enum operations cover comparisons, explicit casts, bitwise OR/AND/XOR/complement and OR/AND/XOR compound updates; additive/increment and other enum compound operators remain incomplete
Switch initializers and GNU case ranges are rejected; switch labels cannot enter generated protected/pinned scopes
Source-defined static constructors currently cover ref/value classes in one translation unit; interface static constructors remain unsupported
Imported generic nested types remain unsupported; indexed compound updates used as values are unsupported; static template-field facades can produce native definition warnings

For each currently requires braced bodies and managed array/reference-enumerator handles; MoveNext currently requires bool; tracking-reference variables and value/native enumerators remain unsupported

Interop attributes remain a selected subset: canonical literal GUIDs, imported interfaces, zero/one positional arguments and selected parameter marshal kinds; LPArray supports SizeParamIndex/SizeConst/ArraySubType only; coclass activation, field/return marshal metadata, other named marshal options and general custom attributes remain unsupported

Native SDK bindings require explicit named x64 COFF import archives; automatic partitioning remains unimplemented; native record pointers remain opaque native addresses, and native integer boxes remain unsupported; system SDK declarations are excluded from user-DLL P/Invoke selection

Delegate support currently excludes nested/generic declarations, open-instance/value-instance binding, source combine/remove expressions and general delegate attributes; imported binding requires an available supported Invoke signature; open-instance and value-instance binding remain unsupported

Managed typeid does not emit native record/enum RTTI metadata and rejects undefined source records; ReliabilityContract currently covers individual method/accessor attributes, with no added runtime CER guarantee
Imported base chains must be explicitly selected; nonempty parameter-array expansion, optional imported arguments remain unsupported
Imported static property facades expose public accessors only; protected accessors require their original method names and retain Clang access checks
Parameter arrays currently support omission and explicit arrays only; source ParamArray declarations and expansion of individual arguments remain unsupported

Primitive static scopes require explicitly selected metadata types; annotated System aliases and common builtin keyword spellings are supported, while user typedef chains, arbitrary keyword ordering and long double remain unsupported
Primitive facades expose static methods and literals only; general primitive instance methods/boxing and imported String/null literal constants remain unsupported
Ordinary global functions from different C++ namespaces currently share IL names; equal-name/signature collisions remain unsupported

Functional String literal constructor adaptation currently covers parenthesized managed value construction; list/direct initialization, user native string buffers and general managed reference literal conversion remain incomplete

Closed C++ managed templates remain an initial subset: CLR generic declarations, general partial/nested specialization forms, template static fields and unused property accessor metadata remain incomplete

Interior returns currently require direct proven managed heap addresses; local pointer aliases, forwarding calls, byref parameters and native/stack addresses are rejected rather than analyzed for escape safety
Pin reinterpret_cast adaptation currently requires an explicit pointer declarator; arbitrary typedef pointer targets and general native reinterpretation remain unsupported

Native reference support covers source parameters/locals with primitive or proven GC-free value storage and no-op casts of proven stable referents; native reference returns, implicit stack-field/temporary bindings, general lifetime analysis and imported native reference signatures remain incomplete

Native records support trivial storage/copy, heap arrays, inline one-dimensional field indexing and integral bitfields with alignment up to 8 bytes; whole-array field initialization, multidimensional array strides, placement allocation, nontrivial constructors/destructors, general native bases/vtables and larger alignment remain unsupported
Native storage types use generated canonical CLR identities; general metadata visibility/import compatibility with other C++/CLI compilers is not yet implemented

Destructor support requires explicit source bodies in ref classes; defaulted destructors, explicit Dispose/Finalize conflicts, stack-semantics RAII and automatic nontrivial member cleanup remain unsupported

Managed deletion supports single handles; native delete[] supports trivial scalar/pointer/POD arrays; placement/custom allocation operators, nontrivial native construction/destruction and full mixed-mode cleanup remain incomplete

Nested source ref/value metadata and public/as_friend internal non-generic nested imports are supported; private/protected nested imports, generic declaring/nested types and nested delegates remain incomplete or rejected

Native value pointer provenance remains a frontend subset over Clang surrogate types; pointer-versus-caret-only overloads/redeclarations are rejected, and imported native value-pointer signatures, native pointer properties/array/generic elements and general expression/lifetime forms remain incomplete

Native value pointers require GC-free value storage and stable caller-owned addresses; arithmetic/indexing use CLR layout; struct pin_ptr/interior_ptr, allocation of managed-value storage and automatic native SDK partitioning remain unsupported

Native import archives currently support named x64 short code imports; ordinal/data/decorated/forwarder forms, by-value native record API signatures, automatic marshalling and automatic Win32 last-error capture remain unsupported
The WPF TrueType subsetter uses an explicit source patch and separate native DLL; generic automatic C++ native partitioning and general native class dispatch remain unsupported

Native COM calli excludes Windows x86, virtual/secondary-base vtables, concrete native classes, bool/managed/by-value-record marshalling, variadic methods and native function-pointer managed/bool/variadic marshalling

Native heap operations cover UCRT-backed scalar/pointer/trivial POD single objects and arrays with alignment up to 8; arrays allow only uninitialized or empty value initialization; nonempty array initialization, placement/custom operators and nontrivial object lifetimes remain unsupported; negative array bounds throw CLR OverflowException and allocation failures use CLR OutOfMemoryException rather than native C++ exceptions; side-effectful single initializer cleanup requires an empty evaluation stack

Native function-pointer calls currently require Windows x64, fixed prototypes, supported scalar/unmanaged pointer signatures and scalar/POD references; managed/bool/by-value-record marshalling, reference returns and arbitrary managed method addresses remain unsupported

Native GUID constant lowering currently recognizes the trusted MinGW __mingw_uuidof macro/template shapes and validates Windows GUID field layout; general native global/static storage and other native constant-reference functions remain unsupported

WPF managed startup is an explicit source port from the native CModuleInitialize/atexit workaround; it initializes before the first factory lookup, uses CLR shutdown handlers and retains the original loader methods, while legacy NGEN dependency attributes remain unimplemented
Native pointer arithmetic excludes void/function/incomplete/array/nontrivial element strides; it preserves caller ownership and does not add bounds checks or pin arbitrary movable managed storage

Const native String facades currently cover single UTF-16/narrow character pointers; other constructor forms require a matching supported metadata signature; narrow pointer decoding follows the source-built CLR constructor rather than custom translation
